scripts.build:packages: pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/core build && pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/catalog build && pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/renderers build && pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/openai build
scripts.dev: pnpm build:packages && concurrently -n server,playground -c cyan,magenta "pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/server dev" "pnpm --filter @ai-interfaces/playground dev"
scripts.test:unit: vitest run tests/policy.test.ts tests/runtime.test.ts tests/catalog.test.ts tests/security.test.ts
